steps.text: Discover the workspace and list prompts
Begin a task for the explicit project and writing profile
Read the target document, address map, and production render
Apply an operation batch with task ID and current hash

text.insert: Use prompts_guidance with the task ID to retrieve the pinned reference catalog or one reference. Agent profile applies the agent section order; single-output profile applies the bounded response contract; generic profile avoids forcing either template. All profiles retain structural and variable checks.

Keep the changeId returned by the save. Call prompts_undo with that ID, the task ID, and the saved current hash. Undo refuses an intervening edit; re-read and decide how to reconcile instead of replacing the expected hash blindly. Check the undo revision before ending.

Preserve the .prompt-kit/changes directory beside each prompt. If a save reports that canonical JSON committed before a later failure, read the current revision and let the next supported mutation recover the derived render under the store lock. Do not patch the journal or derived Markdown as a substitute.

A changed render layout or unrelated canonical revision requires inspecting the reported storage error. Restore the intended path/layout before retrying. Root-scoped undo does not transfer when the project root moves. The complete contract is

Deterministic checks do not replace judgment about clarity, contradictions, repetition, and output usefulness. No MCP tool runs a model evaluation. Request staged internal review through the prompt-editor workflow when that is the intended editing channel.
